title: Shahe deen kubra ki nazro se ye manzar legaye
body:
SHAHE DEEN KUBRA KI NAZRO SE YE MANZAR LE GAYE
Thi Sakina ki sada baba ye kaisa aqd hai
Gul na mehandi ke khile run mein utha kar legaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandar legaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Aarzoo-e-Mujtaba pamal run mein thi padi
Rooh-e-Zehra-o-Ali ko khud dikhakar legaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandar legaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Roke kehti thi Ajal Qasim bane ki lash par
Hath mehandi se range ya khoo’n lagakar legaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandar legaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala ka zarra zarra horaha tha beqaraar
Jab aba mein shahe-e-deen tukde bahattar (72) legaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandar legaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Lash-e-Pamal se dulhan ki nazro’n ne kaha
Dil se mere khoon ke dariya bahakar leaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandar legaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis ghadi randsala pehnaya to bewa ne kaha
Aik hi sa-at mein dulhan ka muqaddar legaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandar legaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Tazkira shadi ka karke ro padi Kubra dulhan
Be kafan hai laash aada meri chadar legaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandarlegaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Hath mein kangne ki ja phir baandh kar rassi hame
Sar barehna darbadar Qasim sitamgar legaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandar legaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Hashr mein Qasim khadi thi jab Hussaini Anjuman
Qasim-e-Noushah sab ko Suwe Kauser legaye
<<MINI>>
Lashe Qasim aur ashkon ka samandar legaye
